name: acorn
description: Configure, price and order custom XT30, XT30(2+2) and XT30 + JST GH wire harnesses from Acorn Harness.

interface.shortDescription: Design and order custom XT30 wire harnesses
interface.longDescription: Describe the cable you need and Acorn Harness turns it into a custom XT30, XT30(2+2) or XT30 + JST GH wire harness: connector, wire length, gauge, straight or right-angle ends, tinned leads and wire colors. Get the exact price and a link to the design, then a checkout link to pay on acornharness.com. Wire harnesses are made to order and Assembled in the USA.
defaultPrompt: Quote 10 XT30(2+2) wire harnesses, 350 mm, 16 AWG, straight on one end and right angle down on the other.
I need 4 XT30 pigtails, 200 mm of 18 AWG with tinned leads. Send me a checkout link.
Make a 600 mm XT30(2+2) to JST GH CAN cable with the signal pair crossed and order 2.
